fields.title: Causal Aging Biomarker and ClockBase

relatedWork.title: Causality-Enriched Epigenetic Age Uncouples Damage and Adaptation

fields.description: The talk presents DamAge and AdaptAge, epigenetic clocks built from CpG sites potentially causal for aging-related traits, and ClockBase, a platform that applies aging clocks to public methylation and RNA-seq datasets.
